Application Data.NAME: Gourmet Kitchen Essentials Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gourmet Kitchen Essentials Inc. specializes in providing high-quality kitchen and home accessories, including cookware, small appliances, and eco-friendly kitchen tools. Our product range is carefully selected to ensure safety and functionality, catering to both home cooks and professional chefs. We prioritize customer satisfaction through exceptional service and knowledgeable staff. In addition to retail sales, we offer cooking classes and demonstrations to engage with our community. Our online store facilitates a seamless shopping experience, while robust cybersecurity measures are in place to protect customer data. We are committed to loss prevention and have implemented comprehensive safety protocols to mitigate risks associated with our operations.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Gourmet Home Décor LLC - 456 Flavor Avenue, Springfield, IL 62704 - A retail store offering a curated selection of kitchenware, tableware, and home accessories, specializing in unique, eco-friendly products.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 07/15/2023, a customer slipped and fell in the store due to a wet floor, resulting in a claim of $2,000. The claim is currently under review and has not yet been settled. Additionally, on 09/05/2023, we experienced a minor data breach involving unauthorized access to customer emails, which incurred costs of $1,200 for cybersecurity enhancements. This incident is resolved, and we have implemented additional security measures to prevent future occurrences.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Combination of CCTV surveillance, security fencing, and regular patrol by hired security personnel.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Cyber Liability & Employment Practices Liability Insurance (EPLI): Cyber cover-
age protects against data breaches and cyberattacks, while EPLI addresses employee-related
claims such as discrimination or harassment.
• Product Liability Insurance: Critical for stores selling electrical appliances, cookware, or
other products with potential safety risks.
Summary
Kitchen & Home Accessories Stores present a moderate underwriting risk profile when
sales volumes and revenue mixes are controlled, and loss prevention measures are in place. Key
exposures include inventory theft, slip and fall liability, product liability, and cyber risks associated
with online sales. Underwriters must carefully evaluate service and installation operations, espe-
cially in high-risk urban locations or when subcontractors are involved. Properly tailored optional
coverages enhance protection and reduce potential claim severity.
